about.title: MY
about.authorTagline: Writer and creator of audiovisual universes.
about.introQuote: “Deeply human stories, compelling universes, and writing capable of traveling between African imaginaries and the territories of international fiction.”
about.p1: Junior France Mavie NGAKOSSO is a Congolese author, creator, and screenwriter developing literary and screen works with a distinct identity and international ambition.
about.p2: His writing spans diverse narrative territories: Thriller, Fantasy, Supernatural, Mystery, Drama, Action, Horror, Comedy, Social Drama, Crime, Psychological, Coming-of-Age, and Political narratives.
about.p3: Rooted in authentic African culture and memory, his work is crafted for audiences and broadcasters worldwide through universal storytelling and high-stakes drama.
about.identityAfricaDesc: An authentic grounding in contemporary realities, ancestral myths, and Central African heritage.
about.identityInternationalDesc: Screenwriting craft and global production standards tailored for international distribution.
about.identityMultiverseDesc: Creative freedom exploring thriller, fantasy, drama, horror, action, crime, and social satire.
about.card1Desc: Mystical forces, psychological tension, occult pacts, and hidden secrets driving gripping plots.
about.card2Desc: Reimagined cosmogonies, dimensional rifts, and investigations into the unexplained.
about.card3Desc: Family fractures, grief, resilience, redemption, and raw humanity standing before destiny.
about.card4Desc: Dense narrative arcs, contemporary conspiracies, power struggles, and high-stakes pacing.

cercueil.title: LE CERCUEIL AUX MUSCLES
cercueil.author: Junior France Mavie NGAKOSSO
cercueil.description: The book tells the journey of a young man facing the death of his father, gradually transforming his body into an armor to hide his suffering.
cercueil.summary: The book tells the journey of a young man facing the death of his father and who gradually transforms his body into a form of armor in an attempt to hide his suffering. The work explores grief, masculinity, pain, family bonds, body relationship, and personal reconstruction.
cercueil.extract: “I built muscles where my heart was bleeding, convinced that an armor of flesh and iron would keep tears from spilling into the light.”

pacte.title: PACTE DU DÉMON
pacte.author: Junior France Mavie NGAKOSSO
pacte.description: A chilling literary plunge into the forbidden corners of ambition, where a desperate secret agreement unleashes supernatural forces with a devastating price.
pacte.summary: Through a tense, gripping literary narrative, “Pacte du Démon” explores human vulnerability confronted with extreme temptation. Seeking an escape from hardship and despair, the protagonists enter a dark pact promising unmeasured fortune. But as the supernatural contract tightens its grip, paranoia and moral collapse take hold, forcing an existential struggle to reclaim one's stolen soul.
pacte.extract: “The shadows never grant favors without demanding the full measure of your soul. When you sign with your own will, what you thought was power becomes your inescapable cage.”

spotlight.title: THE FORBIDDEN
spotlight.tagline: “In Ngoma, the destruction of a sacred forest shatters the Bisengo. The boundary between the living and the spirits crumbles.”
spotlight.loglineText: In Ngoma, following the clearing of a sacred forest, 17-year-old Kito discovers he is the last heir to an ancient power capable of perceiving the mystical fractures threatening his village. Hunted as a sorcerer, he must mend the broken bond between humanity and the forest before the full moon, at the risk of sacrificing his own humanity.
spotlight.synopsisText: In Ngoma, Republic of the Congo, in 2026, the sacred forest that protected the village for generations is cleared in the name of economic development. This act shatters the Bisengo, an ancestral force keeping the realms of the living and spirits separated. Kito Ngoma, 17, an introverted artist, discovers he possesses the Meso Miviri linked to the ancient Weavers. Hunted by villagers, he is supported by his friend Samba, his grandmother Mama Kito, the guardian Maléko, and the spirit Nala to confront the Ba-Mvumbi and the Nganga before the full moon.
spotlight.universeText: A contemporary Congolese village undergoing transformation, caught between aggressive economic modernism and ancestral sanctuaries. The Bisengo, a millenary spiritual harmony, has been violated by machinery, awakening dark spirits.
spotlight.intentionText: Blending the relentless tension of modern action thrillers with the foundational myths of the Congo. An ecological and supernatural parable where youth becomes the ultimate guardian of memory and human harmony.
